response.title: which power station runs home security cameras the most days without power
response.answer:
For keeping home security cameras running during a power outage, the best power station is one with a large battery capacity, low standby power consumption, and expandable batteries.

The biggest battery isn't always the most efficient. Security cameras typically consume relatively little power, so a power station's inverter can waste a significant amount of electricity over several days.

If your goal is the maximum number of days without grid power, I'd prioritize a power station that supports direct DC power, battery expansion, and solar charging.

One important consideration: If your cameras are PoE cameras, a DC battery backup for the PoE switch may last longer than a large AC power station with an inefficient inverter. Your router, modem, NVR, and PoE switch may also need backup power.
